verification.method: scripts/verify/south-africa.py reads the original UN files directly (not the site's generated data) and compares them with the built page, JSON-LD and CSV; the build itself fails if any sentence-level claim (assertClaim) stops being true; then a hand read of title, description, headline, FAQ and story text.
what: Population 1950–2100, rank 2026/2050/2100, share, growth, density, land area; almost nine in ten of Southern Africa; about five times 1950; rising every year to 2100
Net migration 2026 and the second-largest net inflow in Africa after Sudan; natural change 2026 and 2100; migration above natural change in 2100; positive net migration 2030–2100
Life expectancy 1990, 2005 low, now; fertility 1958 peak, now, under 2.1 from 2031; births peak 2008
Pretoria as administrative capital against Encyclopaedia Britannica (britannica.com/place/Pretoria, read 2026-11-25)
Urban share; title, meta description, headline, FAQ JSON-LD, CSV rows, live counter
against: UN WPP 2024 original file WPP2024_Demographic_Indicators_Medium.csv.gz (SHA-256 286ac36b…, downloaded 2026-11-25) and interim update zip (eb7846bf…) — 58 of 58 checks match
UN WUP 2025 original file WUP2025-F15-National-Definitions_percPop_by_category.xlsx (SHA-256 5fdc43a9…, downloaded 2026-11-25); licence CC BY 3.0 IGO stated in the file
verification.result: All figures match. Comparisons name their size group and region; no causes are stated that the UN data do not show. No image alt text on the page (the flag and charts carry aria-labels).
